description:
Implement the relationship-focused graph lenses that help operators understand work structure and execution context.

This work should:
- build the work-topology view for initiatives, backlog items, dependencies, and key scenario relationships
- show how backlog items affect scenarios based on resolved acceptance boundaries and related graph logic
- surface run relationships so operators can inspect workshop/execution/fixup/follow-up history from the same workspace
- make it easy to jump from a selected run to the corresponding agent-manager surface
- support sidebar filtering by initiative, backlog kind, scenario, status, and other high-value controls
- keep the topology readable with sensible defaults, clustering, and selection behavior

This item should focus on the relationship graph itself, not the explanatory flow/reference surfaces.
name: swarm-manager-topology-impact-views
title: Build Topology and Scenario Impact Views in the Graph Workspace
